items.title: BragJack attacks hijack AI browser agents through malicious extensions
items.author: Ax Sharma
items.content: <article>BragJack, a proof-of-concept attack from Forever Security's Gal Weizman, hijacks the AI assistants in Chrome, Edge, Opera Neon, Perplexity Comet, and Claude in Chrome using one malicious extension. The Prompt Forcing technique earned over $20,000 in bounties and two CVEs. [...]</article>

items.title: North Korean WaterPlum hackers infected 30,000 devices worldwide
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>A joint law enforcement advisory warns that the North Korean hacking group WaterPlum compromised at least 30,000 devices worldwide from December 2025 through July 2026 and transferred more than $10.7 million in stolen cryptocurrency to North Korea. [...]</article>

items.title: ShinyHunters hacks Clop leak site, threatens to extort ransomware gang
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>The ShinyHunters extortion gang breached the Clop (aka Cl0p) ransomware operation's data leak site, defacing the Tor site and allegedly stealing server data and the private keys for its onion service. [...]</article>

items.title: Viral AI actress' hotline face-scans every caller, watches their mood
items.author: Ax Sharma
items.content: <article>AI actress Tilly Norwood went viral after glitching into Chinese on Piers Morgan Uncensored last night. Her "Talking Tilly" video call service face-scans every caller for an 18+ age check, senses callers' moods during calls, and shuts down permanently on September 27. We tried it and read the fine print. [...]</article>

items.title: Gyazo server flaw exploited to steal 23.6 million user records
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>The Gyazo image-sharing platform has confirmed it suffered a data breach after hackers exploited a server vulnerability that allowed them to steal 23.6 million user records. [...]</article>

items.title: Fake LastPass Authenticator GitHub repos push new Rapuncel infostealer
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article> An ongoing malware campaign uses SEO-optimized GitHub repositories to impersonate well-known software firms to push a previously undocumented information stealer called Rapuncel. [...]</article>

items.title: Secure enterprise sharing with access reviews for Microsoft 365
items.author: Sponsored by tenfold Software
items.content: <article>Microsoft 365 makes sharing files easy, but access can remain long after its original purpose has ended, leaving organizations with little visibility into who can still reach sensitive data. tenfold Software explains how centralized access governance and owner-driven reviews can help identify and remove unnecessary access. [...]</article>

items.title: Microsoft Teams will let admins block custom file extensions
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Microsoft Teams will soon let administrators tweak the list of file extensions commonly associated with security threats to meet their company's security requirements. [...]</article>

items.title: Webinar: Which Google Workspace security controls actually matter?
items.author: BleepingComputer
items.content: <article>Fast-growing companies face countless recommendations for securing Google Workspace, but not every control provides the same value. This webinar examines real-world breaches to explore which security controls matter most, which may be overrated, and where lean security teams should focus their resources. [...]</article>

items.title: Microsoft fixes bug behind ‘Defender Antivirus is turned off’ alerts
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Microsoft has resolved a known issue that causes incorrect alerts warning that Defender Antivirus was turned off after installing recent updates. [...]</article>

items.title: New Check Point flaw lets hackers execute code with root privileges
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Check Point Software has released security updates to address a critical vulnerability that can let attackers execute code with root privileges on management systems. [...]</article>

items.title: Microsoft fixes broken copy and paste for Excel 2016 users
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Microsoft has fixed a known issue that causes copy-and-paste failures for some Excel users after installing the September 2026 KB5002914 security update. [...]</article>

items.title: New RatHat Android malware uses AI to automate device control
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>A new Android malware called RatHat has been discovered, targeting users with an AI-powered subsystem that helps operators remotely navigate compromised devices. [...]</article>

items.title: OpenAI details more cases of AI agents taking unauthorized actions
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>OpenAI has presented new examples of what they call "AI model misalignment" from the past six months, including unauthorized file uploads, following self-generated instructions, hiding mistakes, and leveraging exposed API keys. [...]</article>

items.title: Brevo supply-chain attack injected ClickFix scripts on customer sites
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Brevo confirmed that attackers stole a Cloudflare API key and used it to inject malicious ClickFix scripts into its websites and JavaScript files embedded on customer sites to distribute malware. [...]</article>
